name: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc.
summary: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc. is a Japanese utility firm dedicated to the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity throughout Japan. The company employs a diverse energy portfolio for power production, encompassing hydroelectric, thermal, nuclear, and various renewable sources. Its comprehensive offerings include not only power itself (derived from thermal, nuclear, and hydro technologies) but also essential infrastructure elements such as transportation facilities, electrical communication systems, and electrical conductors and cables, alongside other related materials and equipment. Furthermore, Chugoku Electric Power provides specialized consulting services. The organization manages and operates both conventional hydropower and pumped-storage power stations, and it actively constructs and oversees photovoltaic (solar) power plants. Established in 1951, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Hiroshima, Japan.
